summary: Today brings a mixed briefing driven by regulatory compliance updates in consumer gold hallmarking alongside major corporate investment announcements from Reliance. In-house counsel should also note international arbitration developments from the DIFC Court alongside key FMCG market performance metrics.

bullets.text: The Consumer Affairs Ministry notified the Gold Hallmarking Fourth Amendment Order 2026, expanding mandatory district-wise coverage to 398 districts across 26 States and UTs.
Reliance announced plans to invest ₹1 lakh crore in Andhra Pradesh to establish biogas plants, creating 3 lakh job opportunities.
Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care reported a 6.7% YoY decline in Q2 net profit to ₹196 crore due to elevated raw material costs.
DIFC Court denied Persephone permission to appeal the setting aside of an $18.4 million DIAC arbitral award against Princeton.
ITC Foods' health brand Right Shift achieved 300% growth, expanding its product line for consumers aged 40 and above with quarterly format launches.
